newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot resid extends rise on crude strength.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot resid extends rise on crude strength.

text.p: U.S. spot residual fuel oil extended Tuesday rise on another rally in crude oil prices linked to increased U.S.-Iraq tension amid military maneuvers by both nations this week, industry sources said.
Although notational physical values in the Gulf Coast and New York harbor climbed again, underlying demand for resid in both markets remained tepid, traders said.
There's no bid, there's really no demand," said one East Coast trader, especially for low sulphur resid grades.
Talks for in high-sulphur materials remained firm, but actual transactions were scant, traders said.
NYMEX October crude futures finished up 63 cents at $24.75 a barrel and NYMEX October Henry Hub natgas futures ended up 1.5 cents at $1.806 per million British thermal units.

In the New York harbor, one percent sulfur resid grade was quoted at $18.25-$18.75 a barrel, up from Tuesday's range of $17.75-$18.00. The NYH three-percent grade was pegged at $16.00-$16.50, higher than $15.50-$16.00 on Tuesday.

In the Gulf, prices for the one-percent grade ended at $16.50-$16.75, up from Tuesday's range of $16.00-$16.25. Three-percent values were quoted at $16.25-$16.50, unchanged from $15.75-$16.00 on Tuesday.

New York city gate September gas prices were assessed in the $2.05 area today, versus NYH one percent resid at a $2.93/mmBtu equivalent. On Tuesday, September New York city gate gas was valued in the low $2.00 range.
